first of all find a sensitivity low enough that makes it easier to follow targets. most players play somewhere from 1.5 to 3 with their DPI kept at default. when i first started playing the game i used to play at 7 or even 8 sensitivity and that was the first key issue i later realized. now u need to know the proper way to use weapons, as you surely know, u have to stop before shooting, but that doesn't mean that you can't move or strafe to make it easier for you to adjust the crosshair onto opponent target as opposed to purely using mouse movement. when you want to stop, tap the movement key opposite to the direction your moving, then fire the weapon. this may seem impractical, but if you practice it enough in deathmatch it will become second nature. this is also essential for mastering the pistol. now the third thing you need to know what shooting technique should you use, spraying is secondary and the pattern for weapons are intuitive. i only spray in close range combat, or if im being flanked and dont have enough time to adjust aim then i go for crouch spray. for close range combat, aim at the head and spray, you dont need to crouch, start pulling down after two to three bullets, of course if you got the kill from first or two bullets then you stop spraying, but the spraying is to guarantee that you get the kill as reliably as possible. for medium range combat, use two to three bullet bursts, and taps/two bullet bursts, i personally think this is the most reliable way to get kills at medium range, its more reliable and efficient than crouch spraying. for long range, never ever spray, use taps, and bursts/taps. i recommend you use one specific weapon model instead of another, because it is a much stronger match to the other, it has higher fire rate insignificant difference in accuracy. you can search for videos on video platforms he teaches you how to shoot with weapons. one time i read on a forum AMA that you can reach a high rank or supreme without having that good of an aim as long as you had very good game sense, so dont be discouraged if your aim isn't so good. about countering people who run and gun, its just something that will disappear after you leave a lower rank. but you can try not to stand in a wide open position, if you do that they will have an advantage over you because they will have faster reaction time than you will since they are the ones entering. also, run and gun only great for close range, weapons are great at all ranges, so if you use range advantage you should have an edge.

this is an old but still useful video to give you an idea of what the game is about, i recommend you watch it https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jdPBKFV1840 ======= the game is difficult for many reasons, some basic reasons are: -you do not have the bird's eye view of the battlefield as you do in other genres,  -the weapons have inaccuracies depending on distance (close, medium, long) pistols and smgs are good in close and medium ranges, rifles are good in all ranges. -the weapons also have inaccuracies while moving, pistols and smgs have it lower so you can move a lot while shooting, but rifles have a high moving inaccuracy, so you need to stop moving before shooting. -economy: when you die you only re-spawn with a weak pistol, you need to use money to buy all the stuff you want. ========= there are many weapons in the game, to make it simpler i will tell you the most fundamental ones you need to learn how to use by playing deathmatch: -pistols: specific pistol models -rifles: specific rifle models -smg: a specific submachine gun is the best smg, but the others are still very good, except the one called a poorly performing submachine gun its bad ========= misc. tips -use a sensitivity somewhere from 1.5 to 3.5 under default DPI (400) -don't spray weapons from long range, use taps or bursts at most. -here's a tutorial on modifying your crosshair https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5CzqbH3GB6s -running makes footstep noises that are audible to enemy. walking is silent. -running with knife is the fastest way to run. walking with knife is the fastest way to walk. you can show speed by typing in console a specific console command -having high fps is very important, use low or very low shadow and shader video options. the effect detail and texture detail can be left at high.
